comment: The NOISE switch is dead. Droplet.cpp:78 runs the whole of process only while the audio input is connected, and the noise DropletAudio.cpp:16-33 generates is reached only when that same jack is NOT connected, so the switch's value is passed to the audio code and never used. That also means the module is inert with the audio jack empty: no output is written at all, so both jacks hold whatever they last carried. The frequency jack is a true 1V per octave input, unlike Rainbow's P. V/OCT, which is halved. The filter type switch offers only the two MaxQ filters; the BpRe filter Rainbow has is not here. Droplet's audio output has no limiter: DropletAudio.cpp:76 writes the sample with no clamp, where Rainbow clamps its output to plus or minus 5V.
